instruction: Create a vSphere content library item from a Packer build
Export a vSphere VM template from Packer
Use the vSphere post-processor to mark VM as template
output: echo 'build { sources = ["source.vsphere-iso.ubuntu"] post-processor "vsphere-template" { keep_input_artifact = false } }' > vsphere-template.pkr.hcl

instruction: Create a Proxmox builder in Packer
output: echo 'source "proxmox" "ubuntu" { proxmox_url = "https://proxmox.example.com:8006/api2/json" username = var.pm_user token = var.pm_token node = "pve1" vm_name = "ubuntu-22.04" }' > proxmox.pkr.hcl

instruction: Create a Hyper-V builder in Packer
output: echo 'source "hyperv-iso" "ubuntu" { iso_url = "https://releases.ubuntu.com/22.04/ubuntu-22.04.3-live-server-amd64.iso" iso_checksum = "sha256:xxxxx" ssh_username = "ubuntu" switch_name = "Default Switch" }' > hyperv.pkr.hcl

instruction: Create a Parallels builder in Packer
Create a LXC builder in Packer
Create a LXD builder in Packer
Create a CloudStack builder in Packer
output: echo 'source "cloudstack" "ubuntu" { api_url = "https://cloudstack.example.com/client/api" api_key = var.cs_key secret_key = var.cs_secret network = "guest" service_offering = "small" template_name = "ubuntu-22.04" zone = "zone1" }' > cloudstack.pkr.hcl

instruction: Create a Yandex Cloud builder in Packer
output: echo 'source "yandex" "ubuntu" { folder_id = var.yc_folder source_image_family = "ubuntu-2204-lts" ssh_username = "ubuntu" subnet_id = var.yc_subnet }' > yandex.pkr.hcl

instruction: Create a Hetzner Cloud builder
output: echo 'source "hcloud" "ubuntu" { token = var.hcloud_token server_type = "cx22" image = "ubuntu-22.04" location = "nbg1" ssh_keys = [var.hcloud_ssh_key] }' > hetzner.pkr.hcl

instruction: Create an Oracle Cloud builder
output: echo 'source "oci" "ubuntu" { availability_domain = "xxxx:AD-1" compartment_ocid = var.oci_compartment image_source_uri = "https://cloud-images.ubuntu.com/releases/22.04/release/" ssh_username = "ubuntu" shape = "VM.Standard.E2.1.Micro" }' > oci.pkr.hcl

instruction: Create an IBM Cloud builder
output: echo 'source "ibmcloud" "ubuntu" { api_key = var.ibm_api_key region = "us-south" image_name = "ubuntu-22.04" }' > ibm.pkr.hcl

instruction: Create a NCloud (Naver) builder
Create a Tencent Cloud builder
output: echo 'source "tencentcloud-cvm" "ubuntu" { secret_id = var.tc_secret_id secret_key = var.tc_secret_key region = "ap-guangzhou" image_name = "ubuntu-22.04" }' > tencent.pkr.hcl
